00073 void LagUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00074 {
00075     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00076     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00077     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00078     float* lagSamples = inputs[LagTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00079     float newLagTime = *lagSamples;
00080     
00081     if(newLagTime != currentLagTime)
00082     {
00083         float next_b1 = newLagTime == 0.f ? 0.f : (float)exp(log001 / (newLagTime * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00084         float b1_slope = (next_b1 - b1) * UGen::getSlopeFactor();
00085         currentLagTime = newLagTime;
00086         
00087         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00088         {
00089             b1 += b1_slope;
00090             float y0 = *inputSamples++; 
00091             *outputSamples++ = y1 = (y0 + b1 * (y1 - y0));
00092         }
00093     }
00094     else
00095     {
00096         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00097         {
00098             float y0 = *inputSamples++; 
00099             *outputSamples++ = y1 = (y0 + b1 * (y1 - y0));
00100         }
00101     }
00102     
00103     y1 = zap(y1); // denormal!
00104 }

00106 void LagUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00107 {
00108     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00109     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00110     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00111     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00112     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00113     float* lagSamples = inputs[LagTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00114     float newLagTime = *lagSamples;
00115     
00116     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00117     
00118     if(newLagTime != currentLagTime)
00119     {
00120         float next_b1 = newLagTime == 0.f ? 0.f : (float)exp(log001 * krBlockSize / (newLagTime * UGen::getSampleRate()));
00121         float b1_slope = (next_b1 - b1) * UGen::getSlopeFactor() * krBlockSize;
00122         currentLagTime = newLagTime; 
00123                 
00124         while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00125         {
00126             float nextValue = value;
00127             if(numKrSamples == 0)           
00128             {
00129                 b1 += b1_slope;
00130                 float y0 = *inputSamples; 
00131                 nextValue = y1 = (y0 + b1 * (y1 - y0));
00132             }
00133             
00134             numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00135             
00136             blockPosition       += numKrSamples;
00137             inputSamples        += numKrSamples;
00138             
00139             if(nextValue == value)
00140             {
00141                 while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00142                 {
00143                     *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00144                     --numSamplesToProcess;
00145                     --numKrSamples;
00146                 }
00147             } 
00148             else
00149             {
00150                 float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00151                 
00152                 while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00153                 {
00154                     *outputSamples++ = value;
00155                     value += valueSlope;
00156                     --numSamplesToProcess;
00157                     --numKrSamples;
00158                 }
00159                 
00160                 value = nextValue;
00161             }
00162         }
00163         
00164         b1 = next_b1;
00165     }
00166     else
00167     {
00168         while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00169         {
00170             float nextValue = value;
00171             if(numKrSamples == 0)           
00172             {
00173                 float y0 = *inputSamples; 
00174                 nextValue = y1 = (y0 + b1 * (y1 - y0));
00175             }
00176             
00177             numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00178             
00179             blockPosition       += numKrSamples;
00180             inputSamples        += numKrSamples;
00181             
00182             if(nextValue == value)
00183             {
00184                 while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00185                 {
00186                     *outputSamples++ = nextValue;
00187                     --numSamplesToProcess;
00188                     --numKrSamples;
00189                 }
00190             } 
00191             else
00192             {
00193                 float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();
00194                 
00195                 while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00196                 {
00197                     *outputSamples++ = value;
00198                     value += valueSlope;
00199                     --numSamplesToProcess;
00200                     --numKrSamples;
00201                 }
00202                 
00203                 value = nextValue;
00204             }
00205         }
00206     }
00207     
00208     y1 = zap(y1);
00209 }
